note: E1-E12: no statement in the 2021 or 2022 report refers to a follower count or the account concerned; E4's 15,000 online visitors is an event attendance figure, not followers. The promise itself does not name the platform.

E5-E8; E10-E11: the 2021 and 2022 reports speak of sludge and rubber-lump waste intensity and a generic 'Waste Reduction Project', but never of a sludge drying project or its being carried out; E11's 24% rise in scheduled waste is a 2022 figure for sludge and rubber lumps combined, not this deliverable.

E5: FY2025 absolute waste 1,028,494 kg vs FY2024 1,035,904 kg (hazardous up, non-hazardous down), but the target is waste relative to the level of business operations and no normalised figure is given; an absolute amount is not the intensity-type target. E8 sets the same aim for FY2026 with no verdict on FY2025.

E7-E8: in the FY2022 table the 2022 PERFORMANCE cell reads 'Two minor health and safety incidents at the workplace' with footnote 5 (E7) describing two employees' muscle-strain injuries, against a target of zero. E12 in the 2023 report appears to show zero under 2022 ACHIEVEMENT, which conflicts; the column assignment of that flattened row is uncertain, so the deadline-year report's footnoted result is relied on.

E4-E5; E7-E8: the Batamindo Industrial Park 7.4 MWp rooftop PV was still 'slated to be ready in 3Q 2024' in the 2023 report, so no green energy was supplied to Batam tenants by 2023 and the deadline moved; E8 puts that system at about 2% of production, far below 20%. E10-E12 confirm operations only began in 2024.

E4; E6; E11: 'In FY2024, Kim Heng reported no incidents of corruption'; Table 23 gives FY2022/FY2023/FY2024 = 0/1/0 and the 2025 report's Table 23 gives FY2023/FY2024/FY2025 = 1/0/0, so FY2024 was zero.

E7-E9; E12: three of the 31 assessed sites were found to have major biodiversity impact; in 2023 management plans were implemented at only two (Fuengfuanant, Thanapakdi), while the third, Sermsuk in the Amata City Chonburi industrial estate (Thailand), had merely been 'notified to work on' a plan. Not all exposed Thai sites had a plan in place by FY2023, and the 2024 report repeats the same position.

E2; E5; E8; E11-E13: the FY2024 report still speaks of SBTi target-setting in the future tense ('will also explore deriving... targets... under SBTi', 'SBTi aligned in the future') and the 2025 report restates the aim almost verbatim as 'aims to establish a decarbonisation target using SBTi's methodology' with no date; nothing reports whether the exploration was carried out or concluded in FY2024. The extracted metric overstates the promise, which was to explore setting targets, not to set them.

E4: 'In the 2023 GRESB Assessment, Suntec REIT was awarded GRESB's 5-Star rating for the fourth consecutive year', which confirms participation in the 2023 assessment. E3, E7 and E11-E12 are the rolling commitments for 2024 and 2025.

E3: in the FY2023 table the contamination row runs 'Maintained annual contamination level at<3%' (2022 ACHIEVEMENT) then 'Maintained annual contamination le...' (2023 PERFORMANCE, truncated but past tense and parallel to the accreditation row, whose 2023 PERFORMANCE cell is a distinct result sentence about the Suspension). E9-E10 report <3% for FY2024, the year after the deadline, not FY2023. The extraction drops the '<'; the target is below 3%, not exactly 3%.
